verdict.rationale: Supabase Auth is an authentication service, so device-flow login for CLIs and headless agents is a fair question to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence documents an OAuth device authorization grant. The pack covers social and third-party OAuth/OIDC sign-in, magic links and OTP, MFA, SAML SSO, and JWT/session management. Those are adjacent sign-in methods, not the device flow itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can authenticate CLIs and headless agents via the OAuth device authorization flow instead of pasting long-lived secrets
